post.description: Selects a nonempty token from JSON body > Bearer header > temprfit_token > repily_token, without falling through an invalid selected token. Missing, invalid, expired or already-revoked tokens return 200 without adding or extending records. An active token requires an acknowledged atomic hash-only revocation with its original expiry. Both 200 and required-storage 503 clear temprfit_token, repily_token and admin_token cookies; cookie removal does not prove server invalidation or revoke unselected credentials. Logout using a predecessor after refresh does not cancel the successor.

200.description: Local cookies cleared; active selected token acknowledged revoked, or harmless/repeated logout

400.description: Invalid request body; cookies are not cleared

503.description: Required revocation storage unavailable or write outcome unknown; cookies cleared without claiming server invalidation

post.description: Selects a nonempty token from JSON body > Bearer header > temprfit_token > repily_token, without falling through an invalid selected token. Requires an unexpired, unrevoked JWT and active user. Prepares and validates a fresh 30-day successor before the atomic predecessor claim, but releases the token and primary cookie only to the single acknowledged winner. Replay or concurrent loser returns 401; required-storage failure or unknown write outcome returns 503 with no replacement token/cookie. Logout claiming first prevents issuance; refresh claiming first leaves its successor unaffected by old-token logout. A committed-but-lost response or post-claim failure may require sign-in again: there is no successor recovery or compensating claim deletion.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, already revoked or concurrent losing token; missing or suspended user

500.description: Unexpected signing, user-model, response or contract failure; a post-claim failure may require sign-in

503.description: Required revocation storage unavailable or write outcome unknown; no replacement token or cookie

get.description: Selects a nonempty Bearer header > temprfit_token > repily_token, without falling through an invalid selected token. Returns the authenticated user with originalRole, or user: null for missing, invalid, expired, known-revoked, missing-user or banned-user sessions. A valid-session required revocation storage failure returns 503, not user: null or 401. Other shared/legacy auth consumers retain their existing outage behavior.

500.description: Unexpected user-model, subscription or response-contract failure

503.description: Required revocation storage unavailable; no authenticated user data returned
